A grep of content/ for 'q-Hermite', 'Touchard' and 'q-Fibonacci' returns nothing, so no block currently consumes any of this. Scope-(a): this document, as read, has no target in the present corpus; that is not a claim that q-Hermite/Touchard-Riordan methods are excluded from the framework - the audit that logged it was itself a q-lift literature check, so it was considered and set aside.
